releases.notes: Trade fills open a new Positions card after a full exit or on a later UTC window, instead of merging onto a sold or prior-window Open card. Docs updated.
Header stats dropdown is Market (since last reset), Schedule (live hour cells), and Replay (last Run). Opening Replay no longer overwrites Schedule totals. Docs updated.
Market log shows Buy GTD place/cancel live on the UTC clock window, without waiting for a refresh or the REST market roll. Docs updated.
Buy GTD does not re-place the same UTC clock window after Apply-end cancel or a late REST market roll. Docs updated.
Buy GTD no longer cancels a rest still inside its UTC Apply because of a leftover empty sync from the previous window. Docs updated.
Market log shows Trigger GTD place (UP/DOWN) when a rest is accepted and Trigger GTD cancel at Apply end. Docs updated.
Buy GTD places at Apply start on the UTC clock window slug, without waiting for the live REST market roll. Docs updated.
Buy GTD places at Apply start and cancels at Apply end. Place GTD before window is removed (no next-window pre-place). Docs updated.

Held Demo/Trade Win/Loss settle from the entry window slug (windowKey), not a rolled live slug. Open Replay held dots are buy side vs Official. Docs updated.

Only the highest Trade GTD card in the Triggers list may rest a buy limit. Replay Run uses one Test card (switching Test pauses the previous). Replay latest-day slots need official Gamma; recorder light-retries Gamma after 20 minutes. Docs updated.

Open Replay fills the viewport on mobile. Play stacks filter dots and Official above play controls and Speed. Hits keeps the same graph height and filter-dot row; play controls stay on Play only. Docs updated.

Account page (was Settings) with Current price: Match Polymarket 30s/60s TWAP or Raw Chainlink — used for Current, Gap, live/demo triggers, and Replay. Current shows (Avg 30s)/(Avg 60s). Positions card borders match that trigger’s color. Docs updated.

Mobile Schedule drops the bottom side-panel arrow. The week table fills the first screen; Trade/Replay triggers sit under the table and appear on scroll. Docs updated.

PTB starts from the first in-window Chainlink tick (PTB (Chainlink)), then REST openPrice (PTB (REST)), then Gamma on Replay last tick (PTB (GAMMA)). Gap triggers can fire on Chainlink PTB. Log body and section-header spacing match other left-column panels. Docs updated.
Open Replay Play tab: green/red/blue dots left of the controls filter the window list (none = all, including gray; multiple = OR). Recording retention default is 7 days. Docs updated.

Live PTB stays REST openPrice (PTB (REST) label). Recordings keep a REST PTB history plus a separate Gamma value. Open Replay steps the gold line and Gap with REST, then applies Gamma on the last tick (PTB (GAMMA)). Docs updated.

Market trigger cards drop Pause/Active: Demo always scores, Trade is always armed when Allow trade is on. Existing Paused cards wake. Schedule Live lists Trade cards. Docs updated.
Trigger card Stop Loss counts as the red Loss dot (not green Sell). Docs updated.
